title: Scaffold apps/electron (electron-vite + TypeScript + electron-builder)
intent: Create the Electron app project that will embed the existing web/ React SPA as its renderer.
checklist: apps/electron/package.json with name, version locked to web app, type=module where appropriate
electron-vite (or Vite + electron-builder) config with main/preload/renderer entry points
TypeScript strict config (tsconfig) for main, preload, and shared
scripts: dev, build, lint, typecheck, test, package, e2e
Directory layout: src/main, src/preload, src/shared, plus renderer pointing at web/
electron-builder.yml with appId, productName, and win/mac/linux skeleton targets
.gitignore for dist/, out/, node_modules/, release/

title: Main process bootstrap + lifecycle + single-instance
intent: App entry that creates the BrowserWindow, manages lifecycle, and enforces a single running instance.
checklist: app.whenReady → createWindow; quit on window-all-closed (except macOS)
macOS activate → re-create window if none
requestSingleInstanceLock; second-instance focuses the existing window
BrowserWindow with secure webPreferences (see e0:security/baseline)
Graceful shutdown: flush state, close SSE, before-quit hook
Window ready-to-show gating to avoid white flash

title: Preload with contextIsolation + typed contextBridge surface
intent: Expose a minimal, typed, validated API to the renderer without leaking Node.
checklist: contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld with a single namespaced object (window.teslasync)
TypeScript ambient types for the exposed API shared with the renderer
No remote module, no nodeIntegration, no direct ipcRenderer exposure
Each exposed method wraps ipcRenderer.invoke with channel + arg validation
Versioned API surface (api.version) for forward-compat

title: Security baseline (CSP, sandbox, fuses, navigation + permission guards)
intent: Lock the app down to Electron security best practices before any feature lands.
checklist: webPreferences: contextIsolation=true, sandbox=true, nodeIntegration=false, webSecurity=true
Content-Security-Policy header/meta restricting to app + API origin (no inline/eval except web build needs)
@electron/fuses: disable run-as-node, cookie encryption on, only-load-app-from-asar
will-navigate + setWindowOpenHandler deny external navigation (open externally instead)
session permission request handler: deny by default, allow only what the SPA needs
Disable or guard webview tag; block insecure content

title: Typed IPC contract (invoke/handle) with validation + error envelopes
intent: One typed, validated IPC layer so renderer↔main calls are safe and discoverable.
checklist: Shared channel enum + request/response types for every IPC channel
ipcMain.handle wrappers with input validation (zod or equivalent)
Uniform error envelope {ok, data?, error?} returned to the renderer
Sender validation (event.senderFrame) to reject unexpected frames
Unit tests for at least one round-trip channel

title: Build tooling reusing the web/ renderer (dev + prod)
intent: Dev loads the running web SPA; prod bundles the web build into the app.
checklist: Dev: main loads http://localhost:3000 (the running web dev server) with HMR
Prod: web build output is bundled and loaded via a custom app:// protocol or file://
Single source of truth for the web build (reuse web/dist; do not fork web/src)
Cross-platform build scripts (no shell-specific assumptions)
Sourcemaps in dev, stripped/secured in prod

title: CI matrix (windows/macos/linux) build + lint + test + placeholder gate
intent: Every push builds and gates the Electron app on all three desktop OSes.
checklist: Matrix os: [windows-latest, macos-latest, ubuntu-latest]
Steps: install → build → lint → typecheck → test → placeholder scan
Path filter so it only runs when apps/electron/** or web/** change
Artifact upload of unsigned --dir package for smoke
Concurrency cancel-in-progress per ref

title: nativeTheme ↔ design tokens bridge (light/dark/system)
intent: Desktop chrome honors the same light/dark theme the web app uses.
checklist: nativeTheme.themeSource driven by the app's theme setting (light/dark/system)
Window background color set from tokens to avoid flash on launch
Theme change event forwarded to the renderer over IPC
Title bar / vibrancy follows theme where supported

title: E0 acceptance gate — app launches with a secure empty shell
intent: Prove the foundation is real: the app starts, loads a blank secured window, passes all gates.
checklist: npm build + typecheck + lint + test + placeholder all EXIT=0
npm run package -- --dir produces a launchable unpacked app
Launched app opens a window with contextIsolation+sandbox verified (no Node in renderer)
@electron/fuses verification passes
All E0 ledger rows are status=done
